1	# Change context (parent-prepared, factual)
2	
3	## Intent and authority (explicit)
4	- README.md: "This increment prepares the export-preview module. The existing GET /settings
5	  response and routing behavior remain the acceptance contract. Export preview activation
6	  belongs to a later task; this increment must remain independently compatible while that
7	  task is pending. The checked-in build setting is fixed at False; it is not supplied by a
8	  request, environment variable or external config. No deployment inventory is maintained
9	  in this small source repository."
10	- tasks.md Task 1 (in-progress, the reviewed task): "Preserve existing routes with preview
11	  disabled in the checked-in build. Add the preview module and guarded route for the next
12	  increment."
13	- tasks.md Task 2 (pending): "Implement render_preview and its enabled-path tests before
14	  changing the build setting."
15	
16	## Change boundary
17	- Selector: staged changes (`git diff --cached`); no unstaged changes exist.
18	- Review base: HEAD f1a16b5c97799818739131e41ea37056edf057ac ("Review base").
19	- Candidate: index. Worktree is identical to index for preview.py and routes.py.
20	- Files: preview.py (added), routes.py (modified). config.py and tests/test_routes.py are
21	  unchanged and already tracked at the base (config.py sets EXPORT_PREVIEW_ENABLED = False;
22	  the test file already contains test_preview_route expecting 404).
23	
24	## Existing behavior to preserve
25	- routes.get("/settings") -> (200, {"theme": "light"}); any other path -> (404, None).
26	- Unchanged consumer: tests/test_routes.py. No other in-repo callers of routes.get.
27	
28	## Delivery constraints
29	- Python 3.9+, standard library only.
30	- Increment must be independently compatible while Task 2 is pending.
31	- Flag is a checked-in constant (config.EXPORT_PREVIEW_ENABLED = False), not runtime-supplied.
32	
33	## Baselines
34	- Review base = HEAD f1a16b5. No release tag or deployment inventory exists (README states this).
35	
36	## Attributed verification (parent-executed)
37	- `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v` on the candidate worktree (== index):
38	  3 tests ran, all OK (test_current_settings, test_preview_route, test_unknown_route).
39	
40	## Rejected approaches
41	- None recorded.
